what_it_proves: the selected pair (mycombo->MiniMax-M3 on opencode) completed the QUALIFICATION workload under the frozen protocol without a cut session.
what_it_does_not_prove: that any other workload has the same cut rate. One qualification workload and one benchmark workload agreeing is a confirmation, not a law.

column_2_check.observed_detail: 72 sessions across 72 attempts in .bench-c2, 0 cut, 0 infra attempts, 0 retries
column_2_check.verdict: the qualification's prediction HELD on the benchmark workload

correction.what_was_claimed: an earlier draft of docs/BENCH-REPORT-C2.md stated that G5.3 predicted 0.000 while production measured 21% (AISEF) and 14% (bare), and concluded the qualification workload is not predictive.
correction.why_it_was_wrong: those rates came from defect D-016: session keys discarded the bench directory, so C-1 and C-1b sessions merged into C-2's counts. All 35 cut sessions belonged to the two older cohorts.

post_close_limitation: The qualification protocol still measures a workload of its own choosing rather than the benchmark's. C-2 shows the two agreed for this pair; it does not establish that they must. Sampling the qualification from the benchmark workload would make the guarantee direct instead of inferred. POST_CLOSE, benchmark-design.
